[[Quel'Danil Lodge]] is the larger of two [[High Elf]] outposts in [[Lordaeron]]. It acts as an embassy of sorts to continue the remaining High Elves' diplomatic relations with other races.


= Quest Guide =

== Quests to Get Before Arriving ==

* {{questlong|Horde|47|Lines of Communication|2995}} - from [[Oran Snakewrithe]] in [[Undercity]]
* {{questlong|Horde|48|Message to the Wildhammer|7841}} - from [[Otho Moji'ko]] in [[Revantusk Village]]

== Quests to Start ==

Inside the lodge is a [[Witherbark Troll]] named [[Rin'ji]]. Speaking to him begins an escort quest from Quel'Danil southward to [[Hiri'Watha]]. After finishing the escort portion of the quest, head to the island east of [[The Overlook Cliffs]]. There will be [[Rin'ji's Secret]].

* {{questlong|Horde|47|Rin'ji is Trapped|2742}}
